label: Microsoft Surface Pro (11th Edition)
description: 13-inch Windows 11 2-in-1 (Snapdragon X Elite or X Plus) sold with a Surface Pro Keyboard, so it is modelled as a laptop rather than a slab. Networking is Wi-Fi 7 with Bluetooth 5.4 on every SKU, and the Wi-Fi + 5G SKU adds a 5G-NR/LTE modem with nano-SIM and eSIM; the ports are two USB-C / USB 4 and Surface Connect, with no RJ45 - a wired link needs a Surface Thunderbolt 4 Dock, a Surface Dock or a USB-C Ethernet adapter.
notes: Microsoft's spec table: 'Ports and charging: 2 X USB-C/USB4 ports ... Surface Pro Keyboard port, Surface Connect port, NanoSIM' and 'Network and connectivity - Wi-Fi only models: Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth Core 5.4; Wi-Fi+5G models: Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth Core 5.4 ... 5G-NR SA/NSA Release 15, DL 256 QAM up to 2.9 Gbps, 4x4 MIMO ... 4G Gigabit LTE Advanced Pro Cat 19'. No Ethernet port and no USB NIC declared; 5.8G is the 2x2 320 MHz Wi-Fi 7 figure. Compare Surface Pro 10, which shipped Wi-Fi 6E/7 depending on SKU.
